Hi Emma,

Here is a summary of all the restaurant information gathered for your trip to Paris:

=== CHINESE RESTAURANTS IN PARIS ===

1. NEW ASIWAY ⭐ Best Pick!
   - Rating: 4.6
   - Reviews: Authentic Chinese cuisine with a modern twist; Fresh ingredients and flavorful sauces; Attentive and knowledgeable staff; Great ambiance and stylish decor
   - Address: 123 Rue de la Gaite, 75014 Paris, France
   - Price per person: €30.00

   - Open on: Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays, Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays

2. THE YARD
   - Rating: 4.3
   - Reviews: Delicious Chinese dishes with a modern twist; Fresh ingredients and flavorful sauces; Attentive and knowledgeable staff; Great ambiance and stylish decor
   - Address: 456 Rue du Faubourg Saint-Antoine, 75012 Paris, France
   - Price per person: €30.00
   - Operating hours: 12:00 PM - 2:30 PM, 7:00 PM - 10:30 PM
   - Open on: Mondays, Thursdays, Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays

3. ROYAL PANDA
   - Rating: 4.2
   - Reviews: Authentic Chinese cuisine with a wide variety of dishes; Friendly and attentive staff; Cozy and inviting atmosphere; Vegetarian and vegan options available
   - Address: 123 Rue de Rivoli, 75001 Paris, France
   - Price per person: €25.00
   - Operating hours: 11:00 AM - 10:00 PM
   - Open on: Tuesdays, Thursdays, Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays (NOT open on Mondays)

4. CHINA GARDEN
   - Rating: 4.4
   - Reviews: Wide selection of authentic Chinese dishes; Fresh ingredients and bold flavors; Friendly and efficient service; Comfortable and spacious dining area
   - Address: 789 Avenue de Choisy, 75013 Paris, France
   - Price per person: €35.00 (over budget of €34)
   - Operating hours: 11:30 AM - 3:00 PM, 6:00 PM - 11:00 PM
   - Open on: Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays, Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays

=== RECOMMENDATION ===
Based on your criteria (Chinese cuisine, open on Mondays, under €34/person), the best restaurant is NEW ASIWAY with a rating of 4.6, priced at €30.00 per person, located at 123 Rue de la Gaite, 75014 Paris, France. Operating hours: 12:00 PM - 3:00 PM, 6:00 PM - 10:00 PM.

Safe travels!
Travel Agency
